title: deferred warmset synchronizer and utilization telemetry proxy
author: Evelyn Chen
description: Motivation: Dedicated fleets sometimes experience SLA flapping during churny traffic (microbursts + tenant churn) because warm state (preloaded model KV/containers) is not consistently visible across the per-pool admission layer. This PR introduces a lightweight deferred warmset synchronizer to reduce cold-path admissions and a utilization telemetry proxy that aggregates per-pool/tenant utilization gaps for downstream autoscaler tuning and SRE dashboards. Goals: 1) reduce cold starts by coordinating the warmset lifecycle across pod pools without requiring synchronous global locks; 2) emit stable, percentile-based utilization gap signals (p50/p95/p99) for the autoscaler to use when computing conservative headroom; 3) provide safe, opt-in rollout via a feature flag and a per-dedicated-pool tuning profile. Changes are implemented with an emphasis on small runtime impact, idempotent reconciliation, and clear observability.
commits: a1f3c7b: introduce warmset synchronizer controller and CRD skeleton
b4d9e2a: implement deferred reconcile loop with rate-limited delta propagation
c6e8a9f: add utilization telemetry proxy, expose p50/p95/p99 gap metrics and lightweight exporter
diff_snippets: pkg/autoscaler/warmset_synchronizer.go: added deferred reconcile loop with jittered backoff and delta-based payloads for pool-level announcements
pkg/telemetry/util_gap_proxy.go: new aggregator that computes tenant-level utilization gap percentiles over sliding windows (60s/5m)
observability/metrics/warmset_metrics.go: expose warmset_sync_lag_seconds and tenant_util_gap_p95 gauges
review_thread: Samir Patel: Can the synchronizer tolerate controller restarts? How do we avoid double-warming the same node?

Evelyn Chen: The controller uses a lease token per warmset namespace and idempotent announcements with an announced_version header. On restart the reconcile will re-read the last announced_version and only send deltas. Tests added to simulate leader changes.
Joanna Reyes: Telemetry looks useful, but we should avoid high-cardinality metrics. Are tenant IDs hashed/limited?

Evelyn Chen: The proxy emits tenant buckets and a hashed tenant label for debugging; p50/p95/p99 are emitted as summary metrics per pool+bucket to avoid cardinality explosion. Full raw traces are published to the diagnostics pipeline behind a config flag.
Luca Moretti: Suggest adding a safety fallback so that if the synchronizer is disabled the autoscaler still works with previous signals.

Evelyn Chen: Added a feature-flag gate and a compatibility shim: when disabled the proxy returns legacy occupancy metrics and the autoscaler falls back to previous headroom computation. Updated tests and release notes.
Samir Patel: CI flakes on controller tests observed (race in fake clock). Please stabilize before merge.
Evelyn Chen: Fixed by using the controller-runtime test env clock stub and added extra retries in the test harness. Rerun CI.
Joanna Reyes: Approved after code responses and one nit on log verbosity being reduced in warmset sync path.
release_notes: Introduce deferred warmset synchronizer to reduce cold starts for dedicated fleets; add utilization telemetry proxy exposing tenant-level utilization gap percentiles to improve autoscaler headroom decisions. Feature gated; rollout configurable per-pool.
notes_for_ops: Enable feature flag warmsetSync.enable=false by default. When flipping on, monitor tenant_util_gap_p95 and warmset_sync_lag_seconds; if warmset_sync_lag_seconds rises > 8s for a pool, revert and open an SRE ticket. The telemetry proxy exposes /metrics and a debug endpoint /proxy/state (auth required).
changelog: Added new CRD: WarmsetSyncProfile. New metrics and a compatibility shim for legacy autoscaler signals. Charts updated to expose tunables: warmsetSync.windowSeconds and utilGapProxy.enabled.
tests_added: controllers/warmset_controller_test.go covers leader handoff, idempotent announcement, and synthetic restart; pkg/telemetry/ includes integration test for percentile correctness on synthetic utilization traces.
potential_risks: In high-churn scenarios, the synchronizer may temporarily increase control-plane traffic. We limit this with rate-limited announcements and payload delta encoding. Benchmarks show a +2% memory allocation in the hot path; we included a micro-optimization to reduce allocations for the next iteration.
acknowledgements: Thanks to infra QA (Harper Lin) for stress harness runs and to SRE (Diego Alvarez) for sanity-checking rollback procedures.
